baselineFindings: Real router with the beta fixture, agent on and off: «El combo 2 por fa» → ×2; reply after the drink pick named the older line's drink; «Solo pedí un combo» → «Por ahora no manejamos: Solo pedí» and one more unit (×4); «Dame solo el combo de pollo número 2» → «Dime qué quitamos» or the combo list; «Cancela ya lo pedí por llamada» → «No encontré…» (agent on: «¿Cuál prefieres?»)
Synthetic menus: on the unavailable-alternatives list «El combo 2 por fa» picked row one ×2; «quiero un combo pollo asado» (exact name) → «Por ahora no manejamos *pollo asado*»
fix: tryResolvePendingMatchPick: a reply made of words shared by every row plus a number («el combo 2», «la opción 3», «combo número 3») selects that row; when the number names the chosen row it is not a quantity (list quantity or 1). buildCartAddReply describes the newest line of that dish. tryHandleOrderedCountDispute (cart chain): «(yo) solo (te) pedí N X», «pedí solo N X», «dame/deja solo el/un X (número K)» when every cart line is that dish — one line takes N, several lines are listed without changes, an equal count says nothing is extra; works in checkout steps and keeps the step. isCancelIntent accepts «cancela(lo)» followed by a reason («ya lo pedí», «ya no lo quiero», «lo pedí por llamada/teléfono»); handleCancelRequest with a registered order today drops an unsent chat cart and names the order, and the refusal no longer appends «No entendí». The off-menu reply for «quiero un …» is skipped when the text fully names a product.

contrasts: a bare row number on the list is still one unit of that row
the disputed count already matching changes nothing
units on lines with different options are listed, not guessed
another dish in the cart leaves the dispute to the existing routes and adds nothing
with a registered order and no chat cart, cancel is refused without «No entendí»
«no canceles el pedido» keeps the cart
